loops.name: Research Intelligence Loop
loops.purpose: Continuously turn official documentation, papers, repositories, standards, advisories, and market evidence into decision-ready intelligence.
loops.trigger: new build, stale evidence, changed dependency, or research request
loops.cadence: on demand plus monthly evidence refresh

loops.name: Product PRD Loop
loops.purpose: Convert verified needs into a complete PRD, acceptance criteria, data model, API contract, rollout, and monetization plan.

loops.name: Architecture and Threat Model Loop
loops.purpose: Design deployable architecture, trust boundaries, failure handling, observability, cost controls, security controls, and rollback.

loops.name: Full Software Build Loop
loops.purpose: Implement complete milestones with migrations, APIs, UI states, tests, security, observability, documentation, and reproducible builds.

loops.name: Test and Repair Loop
loops.purpose: Reproduce failures, determine root cause, implement the smallest correct fix, and prevent regression without weakening tests.
loops.trigger: failed test, bug report, runtime exception, or regression

loops.name: Release and Deployment Loop
loops.purpose: Create signed artifacts, migration and rollback plans, staged deployment, smoke tests, monitoring, and release evidence.

loops.name: Service Monitoring Loop
loops.purpose: Watch availability, latency, errors, queues, costs, security signals, business events, and SLO error budgets.
loops.cadence: continuous with daily and weekly rollups

loops.name: Incident Response Loop
loops.purpose: Triage, contain, recover, communicate, preserve evidence, and prevent recurrence for service or security incidents.

loops.name: Dependency Maintenance Loop
loops.purpose: Track releases, vulnerabilities, licenses, breaking changes, provenance, upgrade tests, and safe rollout.
loops.trigger: security advisory, version drift, or scheduled review

loops.name: Backup and Disaster Recovery Loop
loops.purpose: Verify encrypted backups, retention, restore integrity, recovery objectives, alternate infrastructure, and disaster exercises.
loops.trigger: scheduled backup, restore drill, or disaster
loops.cadence: daily backups, monthly restores, quarterly exercises

loops.name: Website, App, CRM, and Search Experience Loop
loops.purpose: Build and verify the complete website, authenticated app, CRM, forms, content, legal pages, SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO, and entity graph.

loops.name: AI Model Routing Loop
loops.purpose: Route tasks by capability, risk, latency, privacy, context, tool use, and cost with measured fallbacks.
loops.trigger: new model, task class, failure, price change, or quality drift

loops.name: Agent Evaluation Loop
loops.purpose: Test agent correctness, tool safety, instruction following, recovery, hallucination resistance, cost, and latency before promotion.
loops.trigger: agent, prompt, tool, model, or policy change

loops.name: RAG and Knowledge Loop
loops.purpose: Ingest, classify, deduplicate, chunk, index, retrieve, cite, refresh, and delete governed knowledge.
loops.trigger: new source, changed source, failed retrieval, or retention event
loops.cadence: continuous ingestion plus weekly quality review

loops.name: Agent Memory Governance Loop
loops.purpose: Capture useful memory with consent, classify sensitivity, resolve conflicts, compact, retrieve, expire, and delete it safely.
loops.trigger: memory proposal, conflict, access request, or retention deadline

loops.name: Prompt Optimization Loop
loops.purpose: Version prompts against fixed evals, improve measurable performance, control regressions, and preserve rollback.
loops.trigger: quality failure or prompt change proposal

loops.name: Client Onboarding and Consent Loop
loops.purpose: Qualify clients, establish identity and authority, collect signed agreements and consent, provision accounts, and create an auditable service plan.

loops.name: Credit Report Audit Loop
loops.purpose: Securely ingest consumer-authorized reports, normalize bureau data, identify factual inconsistencies, map furnisher fields, and prepare a human-reviewed audit.

loops.name: Credit Dispute Case Loop
loops.purpose: Build individualized, factual, evidence-backed dispute cases with statutory timelines, correspondence records, response analysis, and escalation controls.
loops.cadence: per disputed item and response cycle

loops.name: Regulatory Complaint Escalation Loop
loops.purpose: Prepare fact-specific escalation packages, verify jurisdiction and channel requirements, preserve evidence, obtain approval, and track responses.

loops.name: Credit and Consumer Compliance Audit Loop
loops.purpose: Audit advertising, disclosures, contracts, billing, service timing, dispute records, permissions, retention, and complaint handling against applicable verified requirements.
loops.trigger: quarterly review, law change, complaint, or process change

loops.name: Privacy and Data Rights Loop
loops.purpose: Maintain data inventory, purposes, notices, consent, vendor flows, retention, consumer requests, deletion, and evidence.
loops.trigger: new data use, vendor, jurisdiction, policy change, or rights request

loops.name: Business Credit Progression Loop
loops.purpose: Measure entity readiness, verify registrations and profiles, track tradelines and payment behavior, and progress through policy-defined funding tiers without guaranteeing approval.
loops.trigger: business onboarding or monthly readiness review

loops.name: Funding Readiness Loop
loops.purpose: Analyze documented eligibility, cash flow, debt capacity, credit profile, product fit, required documents, and application risk without guaranteeing funding.
loops.cadence: per funding objective and material profile change

loops.name: Grant and Government Contract Readiness Loop
loops.purpose: Verify eligibility, registrations, opportunity fit, compliance, narratives, budgets, attachments, submission rules, and post-award obligations.

loops.name: Credit Score Analytics Loop
loops.purpose: Track report changes, scores, utilization, payment status, age, mix, inquiries, disputes, confidence, and explanatory limits over time.
loops.cadence: per refresh plus monthly trend report

loops.name: Financial Education Course Loop
loops.purpose: Research, design, build, assess, accessibility-test, publish, measure, and update factual financial education programs.
loops.cadence: per course plus quarterly source review

loops.name: Market Opportunity Loop

loops.trigger: new market question or quarterly portfolio review

loops.name: Offer and Pricing Loop
loops.purpose: Package an evidence-backed offer with scope, eligibility, delivery cost, margin, pricing, disclosures, guarantees policy, and measurable value.

loops.name: SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO Content Authority Loop
loops.purpose: Build people-first topic authority with verified entities, useful pages, citations, schema, internal links, answer blocks, distribution, and measured refreshes.
loops.trigger: content gap, search change, product launch, or stale content

loops.name: Social and Content Distribution Loop
loops.purpose: Repurpose approved source content into platform-specific posts, video scripts, email, community content, and follow-up with consent and claims controls.

loops.name: Conversion Funnel Loop
loops.purpose: Build compliant acquisition paths from message and landing page through consent, qualification, scheduling, purchase, onboarding, and attribution.

loops.name: Lead Nurture Loop
loops.purpose: Route consented leads into relevant education, reminders, qualification, sales follow-up, suppression, and attribution workflows.
loops.trigger: new consented lead or behavior event

loops.name: Sales Pipeline Loop
loops.purpose: Qualify opportunities, document needs, recommend approved offers, manage objections, contract, forecast, and hand off sold work.
loops.cadence: per opportunity with daily pipeline review

loops.name: Reputation Management Loop
loops.purpose: Monitor authorized channels, classify feedback, respond accurately, resolve service issues, request reviews fairly, and learn from recurring themes.
loops.trigger: mention, review, complaint, or scheduled scan

loops.name: Affiliate and Partner Loop
loops.purpose: Recruit, diligence, contract, train, attribute, pay, monitor, audit, and offboard partners under approved claims and privacy rules.

loops.name: Client Delivery Loop
loops.purpose: Plan, execute, quality-check, communicate, obtain acceptance, document value, and close or renew client work.

loops.name: CRM Data Quality Loop
loops.purpose: Validate identities, deduplicate, standardize fields, enforce lifecycle rules, reconcile source attribution, retention, permissions, and auditability.
loops.trigger: record creation, integration event, or scheduled audit

loops.name: Forms and Consent Loop
loops.purpose: Version forms, validate fields, capture disclosures and consent evidence, prevent abuse, create CRM records, and verify failure handling.

loops.name: Billing and Reconciliation Loop
loops.purpose: Validate contract terms, invoicing, payment events, refunds, commissions, accounting records, exceptions, and customer notices.
loops.trigger: invoice, payment, refund, payout, or scheduled close
loops.cadence: event driven plus daily and monthly reconciliation

loops.name: Client Support Loop
loops.purpose: Authenticate, classify, resolve, escalate, communicate, verify satisfaction, and improve knowledge from support requests.

loops.name: Vendor and Integration Risk Loop
loops.purpose: Assess vendors, data access, security, privacy, resilience, contractual obligations, costs, monitoring, and exit plans.
loops.trigger: new vendor, integration, renewal, incident, or material change
loops.cadence: pre-contract plus annual and event driven

loops.name: Document and Policy Governance Loop
loops.purpose: Research, draft, review, approve, version, publish, acknowledge, monitor, and retire policies, agreements, SOPs, and templates.
loops.trigger: new document, law or process change, or review deadline
loops.cadence: per change plus scheduled annual review

loops.name: Cloud and AI Cost Optimization Loop
loops.purpose: Attribute spend, detect waste, measure unit economics, simulate changes, protect performance, and implement approved savings.
loops.trigger: budget alert, usage change, or scheduled review
loops.cadence: daily anomaly detection plus monthly optimization

loops.name: Analytics and Experiment Loop
loops.purpose: Define governed metrics, instrument events, validate data, run ethical experiments, analyze outcomes, and retain decision evidence.
